name_en: Pension Scheme for Transgenders (Tamil Nadu Transgender Welfare Board)
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: If you are a destitute transgender person above 40, you get a monthly pension. The page says Rs 1,000 a month. The Transgender Welfare Board also helps with ID cards, ration cards, house pattas, free sewing machines, higher education help, free skill training, free travel in ordinary city buses, and a grant of up to Rs 50,000 to start a small business.

other: You must be a transgender person.
You must be destitute (no one to support you).

how_to_apply: Register your details on the "Thirunangaial" mobile app to get your transgender ID card. The page does not explain how to apply for the pension.

evidence.quote: a Pension scheme for destitute Transgenders who are above 40 years has been implemented in Tamil Nadu wherein Rs.1,000 is paid as monthly pension.

Identity Cards, Ration Cards, House Pattas, residential Homes, Free Sewing Machines, Higher Education assistance, Self Help Groups, free bus travel in Ordinary fare city buses, free skill trainings, Grant upto Rs.50,000/- for income generating activities.
destitute Transgenders who are above 40 years
Exclusive Mobile App, “Thirunangaial” has been developed to enable transgender to register their details and easily avail Identity Card.
